_about: Analog BD 0.2.0: the lead-in every recorded TR-909 hit (Skee Mask's 70 BPM recordings) shows before its body opens. 0.2.0: every recorded hit rises for 2.25 ms before its main fall (sd 0.07 ms over 160 hits, the previous tail removed). The mean of all hits over the 96 samples before the body opens, from before the rise (so it starts at 0: no step at the trig), peak 1; gain at ATK 0 and 127 (median projection of the low- and high-Attack hits); jitter: uniform half-width with the measured relative sd (Tune Rise, ATK fixed).
